Leaf.description: Crafted from soft canopy foliage and autumn leaves.

features.name: Leaf Leshy
features.tldr: You can catch the wind to glide safely across gaps and slow your falls.

Fungus.description: Spun from subterranean mushrooms and resilient spore clusters.

features.name: Fungus Leshy
